met_analysis:
The Low Pressure Area over North Odisha & adjoining Jharkhand persisted over the same region at 0530 hrs IST of today, 09th August, 2026. The associated cyclonic circulation extending upto 7.6 km above mean sea level tilting southwestwards with height.
The Monsoon trough at mean sea level continues to pass through Bikaner, Kota, Guna, Satna centre of Low Pressure Area over North Odisha & adjoining Jharkhand, Digha and thence southeastwards Eastcentral Bay of Bengal and extends upto 3.1 km above mean sea level.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over Northeast Rajasthan & neighbourhood extending upto 3.1 km above mean sea level persists.
The Western Disturbance as a trough in middle tropospheric westerlies with its axis at 5.8 km above mean sea level roughly along Long. 60°E to the north of Lat. 29°N persists.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over Northeast Assam & neighbourhood now lies over Central Assam at 1.5 km above mean sea level.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over Konkan & neighbourhood now lies over South Madhya Maharashtraat 5.8 km above mean sea level.
